---
title: "How do the error and the design change if we sweep launch speed rather than optimising over it?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# One solve per fixed launch speed, each re-flown through the marched model.
# Holding the speed is the point: optimised, it goes to its bound every time and
# reports the brief back instead of the aerodynamics.
sweep = throw_sweep()

gentlest, hardest = sweep[0], sweep[-1]
ars = [r["aspect_ratio"] for r in sweep]
interior = [r for r in sweep if r["launch_angle"] < THROW_BOUNDS["angle"][1] - 1e-6]

assert gentlest["gap"] > 0.5            # the error survives the gentlest throw
assert max(ars) - min(ars) < 0.3        # and the design barely moves across it
assert hardest["marched"] > gentlest["marched"]   # throwing harder does help
assert all(r["status"] == "Solve_Succeeded" for r in sweep)
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {.hero-ref}
[`{python} f"{gentlest['gap']:.0%}"`]{.hero-value}
[high at the gentlest throw]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{gentlest['marched']:.1f}"`–`{python} f"{hardest['marched']:.1f}"` s]{.hero-value}
[what the throw actually buys]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** Neither moves much. The gentlest throw still reads
`{python} f"{gentlest['gap']:.0%}"` high, so the disagreement was never the speed
bound's doing, and aspect ratio holds within
`{python} f"{max(ars) - min(ars):.2f}"` of `{python} f"{min(ars):.2f}"` across a
doubling of speed. What sweeping buys is the marched column (@tbl-sweep) —
[`{python} f"{gentlest['marched']:.2f}"` to
`{python} f"{hardest['marched']:.2f}"` s]{.key}, each an independent integration,
and a release angle that is a real answer below
`{python} f"{interior[-1]['speed']:.0f}"` m/s.

::: {.callout-warning}
## The throw was not the problem
Holding it removes two active bounds and leaves the disagreement where it was.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Four speeds**, from the brief to the cap.
2. **One start** for every arm, so only speed differs.
3. **Angle still free**, and still bounded.
4. **One start per solve**; basins exist.
:::

```{python}
#| label: tbl-sweep
#| tbl-cap: "Time aloft against release speed, each design optimised at that speed and then re-flown through the marched model. The marched column is an independent integration; the last column is how far above it the collocated solve claimed to be."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
md_table(["launch, m/s", "marched, s", "collocated high by"],
         [(f"{r['speed']:.0f}", f"{r['marched']:.2f}", f"{r['gap']:+.0%}")
          for r in sweep])
```
